title: Final Phase Change
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the phase change phi must be provided as phi = arctan(2/rho).

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the boundary conditions for electric and magnetic fields at the interface.

title: Wave Representation
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately represent the incident, reflected, and transmitted waves using appropriate equations.

title: Correct Use of Refractive Index
description: Important Criteria: The refractive index of the conductor must be correctly incorporated into the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include incorrect signs in the phase change or boundary condition equations.
